name: George W LeMaitre
current_role: Chairman (since 2004) and CEO (since 1992), LeMaitre Vascular Inc. (Nasdaq: LMAT)
profile: Son of vascular surgeon George D. LeMaitre, who founded the company. George W. joined in 1992 as CEO and grew it from a family-owned business into a publicly held global maker of vascular devices (grafts, shunts, valvulotomes), with acquisitions such as Artegraft (2020). His wealth comes from his LMAT stake.
interesting_fact: In Q2 2026 he said Artegraft, LeMaitre's largest product, had become its fastest-growing product, approved in 56 countries and making up 21% of sales.
deep_cut_fact: Before running the family company he earned a B.A. in History from Stanford, worked as a Lehman Brothers investment banking analyst and as an associate at the LBO firm McCown De Leeuw, and was a credit analyst at Connecticut National Bank. He later got a Stanford MBA.
notes: Do not confuse him with his father George D. LeMaitre (founder, died 2018). IR contact named in releases: Gregory Manker, Director of Business Development & IR. Company is based in Burlington, MA.

name: JC Chaudhry
current_role: Founder of Aakash Educational Services Ltd (AESL); Chairman & MD as of 2021; numerologist and motivational speaker
profile: A former botany teacher who started Aakash in 1988 as a small coaching centre in West Delhi. By 2021 it had grown into a national test-prep chain for medical and engineering entrance exams. Byju's agreed to buy Aakash in 2021 for roughly $1bn in cash and stock. He is now also known as a numerologist, author and YouTuber.
interesting_fact: Business Standard reported that he said he did the Byju's deal based on numerology, and that Aakash grew from 12 students in 1988 to 215 centres with more than 250,000 students.
deep_cut_fact: A 1984 debate with his brother-in-law got him into numerology. Using it, he worked out that his real birth date was 18 Nov 1950, not the 1 Aug 1949 his family believed, and confirmed it in 1986 from Faridabad CMO records. He has campaigned for an International Numerology Day on 18 November.
notes: Very public figure through his numerology brand, so his own site and socials are the best route. The Week piece reads as a sponsored feature. The Byju's-Aakash relationship has been contentious, so avoid the topic. I could not verify his current formal title at AESL for 2026.
